subject: Educational Profile and Maintenance Planning
overview: The committee reviewed and approved key documentation for the MSBA eligibility phase, including the educational profile and a maintenance practices questionnaire. Discussions focused on balancing visionary school design goals with the technical reporting requirements for current facilities.

items.title: Minutes and Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous full meeting.

items.title: Deliverable Status Update
items.summary: Jenny Graham reported that legal and committee forms have been approved by the MSBA and noted that a request for feasibility study funds will go before the City Council on June 25.

items.title: Website and Schedule Updates
items.summary: The committee announced that a draft of the project website is available for review and that summer meetings will transition to a remote-only format.

items.title: Educational Profile Approval
items.summary: Approved the educational profile as amended following a debate over whether the document should reflect current conditions or provide a visionary design concept for future spaces like the library and performing arts center.

items.title: Maintenance Practices Questionnaire
items.summary: Authorized Jenny Graham and Peter Cushing to finalize and submit a mandatory questionnaire detailing the district's facilities staffing, preventative maintenance software, and capital budget history.
